NCAA Division I Wrestling — Placewinners & Qualifiers by College

All entries were extracted from the yearly tournament bracket sheets.
Compiled by Roland Kays
Preliminary results — this dataset is a work in progress and still being checked. Please keep it to yourself for now and don't redistribute; happy to share more widely once it's finalized. Thanks!
Each marker = one entrant at that year & weight. Colored by finishing place (gold=champion … 8th); grey square = qualified/seeded but no top-8 place. Lines connect the same wrestler across years (matched on canonical name). Y-axis = weight class in ascending order; labels reflect the selected school's actual classes (they shift over eras, e.g. 118→125). Scroll horizontally for all years.
